title: 1952 official denial of secret development
summary: unnamed official tells of 1952 official denial of secret development, about 1952 at Washington, D.C., and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We can say that the recent sightings are in no way connected with any secret development by any department of the United States.

plain: In 1952, during a run of UFO sightings, an unnamed official in Washington, D.C. stated that the recent sightings were "in no way connected with any secret development by any department of the United States." The statement is read out as an official's own words on Jesse Michels's show, in an episode with an online researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala. It matters because it rules out the obvious explanation that the objects were secret American aircraft.
